digest.component_or_area: rebar link resolver and hierarchy comparability
propositions: Blocking-link comparability currently decides from ticket TYPE_TIER instead of structural position in parent hierarchy, causing silent edge rewriting and self-blocking edges.
A ticket can end up depends_on its own descendant or ancestor, distorting ready/next-batch work orders and violating the parent-first cascade claim.
Escalation of cross-subtree blocking links silently substitutes a different edge than requested without surfacing the redirect record to library and MCP callers.
The resolver must decide comparability from nearest-common-ancestor structure alone, making ancestor-blocking edges unrepresentable by any code path.
Legacy edges written under the old type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass without breaking the escalation contract.
